text:
Tess: Who's in the soggy commuter club today? Pier 4 line was chaos at 8:10.
commute-bot: FERRY UPDATE: Pier 4 boarding delays 20-40m due to unexpected passenger surge. Recommended alternate terminals: Pier 1 or 3.
Kai: Yep, had to queue twice because of a gate shuffle. Coffee vendor made it bearable though. :coffee:
Ruth: Bike lane near 2nd & King turned into a miniature canal. Lost one shoe. Not proud.
Sam: Lost my sunglasses to the wind near the overlook. If anyone finds tortoise-shell shades, that's probably me. :sob:
Tess: Garage note 9: lower level sensors tripping when it puddles; security says avoid spots by the east pillar.
commute-bot: MUNI: 8X and 30 experiencing delays due to traffic signal issues on 3rd St.
Kai: Office offer: I brought a pack of dry socks and left them on the kitchen counter labeled "survivors". Help yourselves. :socks:
Ruth: Bless you. Also, mini poll 9:30 "dry shoe" meetup in the lobby? React with :raised_hands: if you want to swap tips.
Sam: :raised_hands: (will bring duct tape for emergency beanie repairs)
Tess: Also FYI someone reported a pop-up promo at Pier 4 with free espresso that apparently doubled the queue. Worth it if you made it through.
commute-bot: NOTE: Pier 4 surge expected to subside ~10:00. Ops monitoring.
Kai: Alright, see you at the lobby if you're coming. Stay dry-ish. :umbrella:
